newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver, gold edge up speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver, gold edge up speculative buying.

text.p: Gold and silver prices opened on a firm note and lifted further towards the close on the back of speculative buying following reports of modest recovery in the world market, dealers said on Tuesday.
"Physical enquiries however remained low and trading volume was at low ebb," one dealer said.
Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 100 rupees higher at 59,850 rupees per piece. They were down by 50 rupees per piece on Monday.
